svg.title: Speculative RAG custom architecture
svg.desc: Five phases. Phase 1 is hybrid retrieval with dense and BM25 search fused by RRF into top 10 chunks. Phase 2 clusters chunks with k-means into two clusters and maps them to five subsets of two docs via rank-stratified round-robin. Phase 3 runs a 3B drafter in parallel on each subset, producing rationale then answer pairs. Phase 4 scores each draft with a verifier using self-consistency and self-reflection, combined into a composite score. Phase 5 takes argmax as the final response.

g.text: Map 10 chunks into 5 subsets (2 docs each)
Prompt: generate rationale β FIRST, then α
+ Metadata: Latency, Token Savings, Winning Confidence
